gloss: after the rain; clearing up after rain

definitions.gloss: after the rain; just after rain stops
definitions.explanation: The period right after rain has stopped. Often evokes a fresh, clean atmosphere and carries aesthetic or poetic connotations.

examples.english: A rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.

examples.japanese: {雨上|あめあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}たまり→水たまり：19427_mizutamari⟧⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧だった。
examples.english: The road after the rain was full of puddles.

examples.japanese: {雨上|あめあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{木々|きぎ}→木々：04811_kigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When I took a walk in the park after the rain, the green of the trees looked more vivid than usual.

notes:
USAGE:
{雨上|あめあ}がり is used as a noun modifier ({雨上|あめあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～) to describe the time, atmosphere, or conditions just after rain stops. It carries a pleasant, refreshing connotation — the air feels clean, colors appear vivid, and there is a sense of renewal.
The word is formed from ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ (rain) + ⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (the end of; finishing). The same ～⟦{上|あ}がり→上がり：25038_agari⟧ pattern appears in other words like ⟦{風呂上|ふろあ}がり→風呂上がり：22451_furoagari⟧ (just out of the bath).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨上|あめあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (the sky after rain)
- {雨上|あめあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (the road after rain)
- {雨上|あめあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ (the smell after rain)
